messages:
alex: Heads-up: rolling v2 across the gateway tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window (02:00-03:00). Plan: staged traffic shift 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~40m. Canary first at 5%. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2-2026-03-20

alex: We'll pin older mobile SDKs: serve v1 for SDK versions < 1.4.3 to avoid auth/header mismatches.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @alex for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Starting canary: gateway-v2-canary-1.

sam: Quick note: header normalization change in v2 — clients that send multiple Authorization headers can get a 400. Recommend temporary shim on gateway to collapse duplicate headers for the canary.

maria: I saw a failing pagination test against v2 in staging earlier. limit/offset parsing changed. Repro: POST /v2/search {"q":"x","page":2}. Pushing a patch to canary now.

jen: ops oncall — what's our pause/rollback threshold? Suggest: >1.5% 5xx OR p50 latency increase >200ms triggers hold.

alex: Agree. Policy: pause if 5xx >1% for 10m OR p50 regresses >150ms. Rollback plan = pin to v1 via gateway-route instantly + notify clients.

devops-bot: Initiating canary shift -> 5% traffic to v2 at 02:05 (1901234620). Logs: starting instances, health probes enabled.

alex: Shift command run:
```
/shift-traffic --route api.v1 --to api.v2 --percent 5 --actor @alex
```

deploy-bot: Health-checks: canary healthy (error_rate=0.2%, p50=85ms). Continuing.

iris: QA running full v2 regression suite against canary nodes; ETA ~8m.

maria: Pushed pagination fix to canary, tests pass locally.

deploy-bot: 02:12 -> shifted to 25% (1901234685). Observed: error_rate=0.9%, p50=110ms.

sam: Seeing spike in malformed-header logs from mobile 1.3.x devices (~45/min). Recommend immediate pin of mobile 1.3.x to v1 via gateway rule.

alex: Do it. @jen please apply mobile pin rule.

jen: Applied pin for mobile SDK <1.4.3 at 02:15. Confirm: those mobile users now routed to v1. (1901234760)

deploy-bot: Metrics after mobile pin: error_rate down to 0.35%, p50=95ms. Proceeding to 50% at 02:25. (1901234820)

devops-bot: Autoscaler warm, no resource pressure.

maria: Regression fixed in canary; search suite shows no failures.

deploy-bot: 02:33 -> shifted to 100% (1901234900). Health: error_rate=0.6%, p50=105ms.

sam: Suggest hold at 100% for 10m before global cutover of other regions.

alex: Agreed. Monitoring window open. If >1% 5xx or repeated client regressions, we rollback. Creating rollback ticket RW-7891. (1901234955)

deploy-bot: Rollback ticket RW-7891 created. Rollback playbook: pin gateway-route to v1, revoke traffic-shift locks, run client-notify script.

jen: Release notes and ops runbook updated with mobile pin detail and troubleshooting hints.

alex: Closing the window at 02:55 UTC. Outcome: full rollout completed for API v2 with a mobile SDK pin in place. Thanks all. :tada: (1901235012)
